    The global continuation basis of a string-arrow right ideal #

    The product decomposition of the represented arrow range supplies a basis indexed by all surviving paths before the arrow, with their starting vertices retained.

    Collecting the fixed-startpoint continuation types over all displayed vertices gives the manuscript's complete left-continuation type.
